A '''skirmish line''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[Captain of the Line/Legends|captain of the line]]. Numbering between four and twenty [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], they were comprised mostly of [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] or similar. Skirmish lines were intended to engage larger starships and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The use of skirmish lines diminished with the rise in popularity of the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] of starfighters, but regained their status as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] equipped themselves with better armaments. TIE [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] used skirmish lines as mobile cover, while the line itself provided supporting fire to the starfighters.
